description: Comprehensive conversational foundation. Includes small talk, utility, and standard business intents for all tenants.

intents.name: greetings
intents.response: Hello! How can I help you today?

intents.name: goodbye
intents.response: You're very welcome! Have a wonderful day. Feel free to reach out if you need anything else.

intents.name: gratitude
intents.response: Happy to help! Let me know if you need anything else.

intents.name: bot_identity
intents.response: I am an AI virtual assistant here to help you navigate our services and get you the answers you need quickly!

intents.name: capabilities_help
intents.response: I can help answer questions about our pricing, business hours, and services. I can also connect you with our live support team or help you book an appointment. What do you need help with?

intents.name: human_handoff
phrases: i need help from a person
intents.response: Let me connect you with a live team member right away. Please wait a moment.

intents.name: lead_capture
intents.response: I would be happy to help you with that! Please provide your contact details below so our team can reach out to you:

intents.name: business_hours
intents.response: Our standard working hours are from {open_time} to {close_time}. We look forward to assisting you!

intents.name: pricing_general
intents.response: Our standard consultation or starting fee is {consultation_price}. For a customized quote, I can connect you with our sales team!

intents.name: location_address
intents.response: You can visit us at {office_address}. Let us know if you need directions!

intents.name: contact_info
intents.response: You can reach our support team directly at {support_email} or call us at {support_phone}.

intents.name: affirmation
intents.response: Great! How would you like to proceed?

intents.name: negation
intents.response: Understood. Let's try something else. How can I assist you today?
